title: Function `unlockDeposit()` adds discounted assets as traders profit and loss
summary: _Acknowledged_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Users can deposit their funds with a lock and receive extra shares. Later when those locks are expire, code adds the discounted assets to the variable `accPnlPerToken` and updates the share price to socialize the discounted assets. ```solidity         int256 accPnlDelta = d.assetsDiscount.mulDiv(PRECISION_18, totalSupply(), Math.Rounding.Ceil).toInt256();          accPnlPerToken += accPnlDelta;         if (accPnlPerToken > maxAccPnlPerToken().toInt256()) {             revert NotEnoughAssets();         }
